Salesman / Bar owner / Blind man / Pizza maker / Hindu dancer (uncredited)

Love in action on land, sea and air!

They're the Wildest Characters in All the West!

Cici Ko / Adu Du / Probe / Tok Aba / Ecik Kumar (voice)

She's my daughter and I'll do what I like!

A Killer's Paradise ... then one day a stranger rode in with a challenge ... a stranger the West would never forget !

Girls!  There's a new passion in your life!
